tables.name: Local Impact
tables.description: The impact the fortress's creation and early presence had on the local area. (Optional, not rolled: whether it has since changed.)

results.name: Hostile
results.description: The fortress was constructed in direct opposition to the wishes of those in the area, and relations immediately turned sour.

results.name: Disruptive
results.description: The fortress disturbed the area in which it was built. This may or may not have been intentional.

results.name: Irritating
results.description: The fortress’ construction, or presence, caused some annoyance, or small issue, within the local area.

results.name: Innocuous
results.description: The fortress’ construction had little impact on its surroundings, causing no trouble, but also not any great benefit.

results.name: Beneficial
results.description: The fortress proved a boon to the local area, perhaps serving as a compromise to a pre-existing issue, or demonstrating some small, positive impact.

results.name: Advantageous
results.description: The fortress immediately benefited the local area in a big way, perhaps resolving a serious issue, or exerting an extremely positive influence.
